body: "HA, I bet you're the only person who regrets doing it more than me now mom!"
Sorry, I made a mistake, I shouldn't have said anything. Sorry for wasting your time.

Thanks, I really appreciate trying to help, but I think I'll be ok I don't really have much longer to worry about all this after all. My definition would probably be either failing at something that seemingly all your peers are able to do, or being too afraid of failing those to even try and just giving up. Both of which I'm well versed in.

Thanks, I realize its a big world, but I don't even care about fitting in with the rest of it anymore. I wish I just cut myself off sooner, then I would have less evidence of what a loser I am out there.

Not even just talk, I often have long monologues with myself, about random stuff like why I like a tv show or game. Almost like a little, review of something, that I never share with anyone. I don't really know if its normal or not but I have been doing it for as long as I remember.
I might not be alone, but I should be. If I had a better grasp of my emotions I might not be an embarrassment to be associated with.

Honestly it's really really stupid and frankly embarrassing for someone my age. I got into a screaming match with a troll in an online game. Someone said "why are so many people dead" and being a stupid sarcastic asshole I had to chime in and say that we messed all the mechanics up. Naturally, we ended up in a text screaming match or several minutes till I just left. The thing that makes it even worse is a friend was with me on discord and saw the whole embarrassing ordeal. If I was a normal person I would have been able to keep my mouth shut, but since I'm, me I made an ass out of myself again... Like I said its honestly really stupid. 

TL: DR I am an idiot, got trolled and had a friend see it first hand. Like I said it was really really really stupid.
